newsitem.title: UK: Blick says yr pretax profits over 15 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Blick says yr pretax profits over 15 mln stg.

text.p: Blick Plc said it still expected year pretax profits to be over 15 million stg compared with 14.2 million stg in the year ending September 30 despite "somewhat mixed" trading in its main businesses in the last quarter.
It also announced the launch of a new European company in which it will hold 51 percent, ABI (Europe) Ltd, as part of the joint venture announced with Amano in July.
Blick's shares were indicated down five pence at 523 pence in the pre-market.
Blick said ABI (Europe) Ltd would require "significant investment" in software and infrastructure in 1997 but had "exciting prospects".
It said the move was part of the company's strategy to speed investment to take advantage of converging technologies in access control, time management and security systems.
But it added that as a result, slower growth was expected in 1997.
Results for the financial year 1995/96 are due on December 4.
